$comment: The Mission of St. Gamaliel's Trisagion, sent by Erez 2026-08-06. Their form addresses God in the second person — 'You are holy — God' — where the app's own Hebrew declares 'Holy is God', and it is headed by the Aramaic word the Syriac churches sing it under, קדישת (Qadishat). The ✠▼▲ marks stand exactly where they were sent: ✠ is the cross signed at the opening, as in the Mission's other Trinitarian formulae. trisagionShortAcclamation is composed from their own third and fourth lines, which is what the short form is in every tradition — the one line here not sent verbatim, and the one to confirm with Erez.

prayers.trisagionAcclamation:
אַתָּה ✠▼▲ קָדוֹשׁ – אֱלוֹהִים
אַתָּה קָדוֹשׁ – חַיִל
אַתָּה קָדוֹשׁ – אַלְמָוֶות
תְּרַחֵם עָלֵינוּ
